status: Round 2 evidence frozen after v3 hardening. Development cross-validation only.
approved_by_owner: WP2 approved 2026-11-13, without a git tag (a tag may be considered after the WP5 owner's review)

reproduction.summary: B1, D1, F10 regenerated on all 6 inner folds from the frozen features: 18/18 packets byte-identical to the registered ones (max |score diff| 0; H_bal identical at all 65 gamma points)

packet_sweep.summary: 725 historical packets (v1 213, v2 218, v3 294) pass the strict contract; all duplicate copies byte-identical

standing.D1_synthComp_norm: Provisional Round 2 research candidate. v3 Phase 1: +2.62 pp vs B1, 6/6 folds; nested +2.23 pp, 6/6. Development evidence only.
standing.F10_concat_convnext: Not promoted. Passes the in-sample gate (+2.12 pp vs D1, 5/6) but nested +0.89 pp, 4/6 does not meet the gate thresholds; gain concentrated in I1; less robust than D1 under source ablation.
standing.D2_synthComp_norm_text: Historical. v1 development winner; does not pass against D1 in v2 or v3 (v3: +0.39 pp, 3/6). Its v1 results stand as recorded.

claims_not_permitted: No independent or blind-test claim for any Round 2 model.
The v2 outer folds are already examined; they are not fresh confirmation.
No claim that D1 outperforms the accepted submission models on the official benchmark.
official_test_use: none in Round 2 (no fitting, selection, inference or debugging on either official test set)
post_freeze_rule: Any further optimisation or analysis on the examined v3 inner folds is labelled 'post-freeze exploratory'. It cannot change the standing above. A change of standing needs a newly predeclared protocol, an evaluation population not used for development, and review by the WP5 owner.
submission_separation: Round 2 changes nothing in the accepted WP1/WP2/WP3 checkpoints, WP5 evaluation, LeafLens GUI, report, slides, video or submission assets. PR #34 stays a draft.
open_limitations: No untouched evaluation population remains inside the 8,000 training images.
The packet registry is retrospective: it pins the packets; their origin rests on the run-time summaries and the regeneration check (B1, D1, F10 only).
Source-stress results confound source novelty with training volume and candidate-universe changes.
Frozen features with linear heads only; fine-tuning and other encoders untested.
